label: Precomputed whole-brain simulation (Shiu LIF on FlyWire v783)

provenance.model: Leaky integrate-and-fire, numpy port of Shiu et al. 2024 (Nature, doi:10.1038/s41586-024-07763-9) from the organizers' fly_brain_starter.ipynb

trial.input: Independent Poisson kicks to every cell in the stimulated group at the given rate
trial.rate_units: Hz (spikes/s), mean over cells in the group, over the measurement window
trial.state: fresh resting state for every trial; no carry-over between conditions

plasticity.bitter: Multiply weights of all outgoing synapses of bitter GRNs (cell_sub_class == 'bitter').
plasticity.loom_gf: Multiply weights of synapses from LC4/LPLC2 onto DNp01 (Giant Fibre) only.
plasticity.note: Scales are persistent between game runs; each 200 ms trial starts from rest. The rule that moves the scales is a game rule, not a biological learning model.
